description: This Java class defines a command to delete a feature's properties from an IoT-like thing, including parsing from JSON, generating JSON payloads, and handling command metadata. It is part of the Eclipse Ditto project and provides an immutable representation of this delete command.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureProperties
classes.description: Immutable command class that deletes properties of a specific feature on a thing within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory methods for creating an instance with either string IDs or typed ThingId, with deprecated and current versions.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing this command targets.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this delete command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer resource path for the feature's properties.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command's payload to a JSON builder, considering schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, in this case, DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets new Ditto headers, returning a new instance.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization; returns false.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code considering all relevant fields.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on thing ID, feature ID, and superclass fields.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equality checks specifying class type compatibility.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command.
